schema.description: One sleep episode as an IEEE 1752 sleep-episode-1.0 body (Open mHealth, pinned), with the source's own fields beside it. Garmin writes one per day, through the anam_garmin importer (source garmin), from GarminDB's sleep table; other sources may write it with their own id. The time frame, durations and is_main_sleep are the IEEE body; id, score, qualifier and the averages are the source's.

id.description: The source's key for the episode, prefixed with what it is. For Garmin, "sleep:" and the sleep table's day: the date Garmin files the night under, the day you woke. For Fitbit, "fitbit:sleep:" and the local start. Under one source no two types share an id: a facet's id is the source plus its identity values, without the type.

effective_time_frame.description: When the episode ran, as an IEEE 1752 time interval. Start and end in UTC; the start is the fact time.

total_sleep_time.description: Time asleep within the episode as an IEEE 1752 duration-unit-value in minutes, as the source reports it.

light_sleep_duration.description: Time in light sleep as an IEEE 1752 duration-unit-value in minutes, as the source reports it.

deep_sleep_duration.description: Time in deep sleep as an IEEE 1752 duration-unit-value in minutes, as the source reports it.

rem_sleep_duration.description: Time in REM sleep as an IEEE 1752 duration-unit-value in minutes, as the source reports it.

wake_after_sleep_onset.description: Time awake between falling asleep and the final waking, as an IEEE 1752 duration-unit-value in minutes, as the source reports it.

is_main_sleep.description: Whether this is the main sleep rather than a nap, as the importer judges it. Garmin's sleep table holds one sleep per day, its main one, so Garmin's are true.

score.description: Garmin's sleep score, 0 to 100. Garmin's own measure; absent when Garmin gave none.

qualifier.description: Garmin's word for the score, as it wrote it.

avg_spo2.description: Garmin's average blood oxygen saturation over the episode, in percent. Absent when not measured.

avg_rr.description: Garmin's average respiration rate over the episode, in breaths per minute.

avg_stress.description: Garmin's average stress level over the episode, on its 0 to 100 scale.

awake_count.description: Fitbit's count of times awake in the episode, as its sleep log (written by an IFTTT applet) reports it. Absent for other sources.

restless_count.description: Fitbit's count of restless spells in the episode, as its sleep log reports it. Absent for other sources.

restless_minutes.description: Fitbit's time restless in the episode, in minutes, as its sleep log reports it. Absent for other sources.
